exposure.needed: whether an issuer is in back-off at runtime and its linked Secret then gets updated

consequence.statement: When an issuer's linked Secret is updated, the issuer retries sooner instead of waiting out a long back-off timeout.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, an issuer retries sooner after its linked Secret is updated, which fixes a bug that caused a long back-off timeout.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
